greet.text: Sit, sit. I trade in what people would rather not say aloud, and I never ask what you plan to do with it. Names, routes, debts. Everything has a price.

choices.label: Ask what moves through the market.
Buy him a cup of rice wine and let him talk. (2 days, 10 stones)
Ask if he needs anything found.
Bring the two Star Silver Shen asked for.

rumours.text: Sect envoys buy herbs by the cartload before a breakthrough season, and prices follow them. The crater keeps spitting out star metal, and the foolish keep dying in it. Both are opportunities.

wine.text: His hollow eyes brighten for an hour. By the second cup he has told you three secrets, two of them true.

errand_ask.text: A client of mine wants star silver, quietly, and the crater has made my usual diggers cautious. Two lumps from the Meteor Crater Field. I will pay well, and not ask who you are.

errand_thanks.text: Clean silver, no star-fire left in it. You have good hands, friend. My client pays, I pay you, and no one ever learns your name.
